spell.toggleTip: When you pause typing, misspelled words get a red wavy underline. It shows on screen only and never goes into saved, printed or exported files. The dictionaries are those of the language packs installed in Windows.
spell.web: The browser version has no spell checker (use the Windows app).
spell.missing: No spelling dictionary for: {langs}. Add the language in Windows Settings ▸ Time & language ▸ Language & region to check it.
